question: Was the gun hit at St. Elia on 18 Feb the German report's 'Einzelgeschütz'?
claim: Battery A (1st Bn) at St. Elia was shelled 0900-0930 and 1400-1515 on 18 Feb; a 90 mm gun "received direct hit causing piece to be temp. inactive"; one killed
note: Shelling "believed to be result of direct ground observation" (the battery's belief).

question: Was the gun hit at St. Elia on 18 Feb the German report's 'Einzelgeschütz'?
claim: The 5th Mountain Division's artillery fired that day on troops marching out of XXIII 97 (Sant'Elia) and "vernichtete eine Feindbatterie und 1 Einzelgeschütz"
note: No square or hour for the battery or the gun; the corps artillery commander's reports for 17-18 Feb, which on 16 Feb gave the squares, are not on the film (folios run 141/17 to 169/17 without them).

question: Was the gun hit at St. Elia on 18 Feb the German report's 'Einzelgeschütz'?
claim: Same day and area at most: the gun was "temp. inactive", not destroyed, and the German claim names no place
note: A lead, not an identification: other Allied guns stood around Sant'Elia that day, and a destroyed-gun claim is the firer's claim.
